about_the_game:
Hand Crafted Open World

Explore the Scarred Lands, a hand crafted open world full of things to explore and find. Traverse the landscape by unlocking certain areas and platforming between locations with a new interesting useful item around every corner.

The Elder Knights

A powerful order of people who were gifted the powers of the Elder Storms, able to summon lighting and high amounts of energy. They wield their powers through Hilts that form the shape of different weapons with different properties. These abilities also allow the Elder Knights to have superior combat abilities like harnessing Stones of Knowledge similar to talismans and having superior movement capabilities.

Intense Parry based Combat

Fight, dodge, and parry enemies breaking down their health, parry enemies to break their stance and go in for heavy damaging blows. Not all attacks can be parried due to being too powerful so you must dodge out of the way to avoid it. Each sword has a unique weapon art that does high damage in differing ways to give more unique build opportunities.

Upgrades

Upgrade using voltage taken from the death of enemies or finding voltage items through out the Scarred Lands. Use this currency to upgrade your attributes to become stronger and do more damage. You can also use it to upgrade weapons when you fight the right materials. 

Story Rich World

The Scarred Lands contains futuristic sci fi technology stuck in a medieval like age due to fast development and evolution. A place lost to war plunged into ruin. Lord Abaddon of the Saurian Empire seeks to enact revenge on the people of the world for doing nothing as the Saurians stayed locked in their icy prison. His goal, to conquer the ones he deems evil, killing and controlling them with the full faith and support of his nation as he leads them to their new paradise outside of the starving bitter cold. Despite the mistakes of the past you must fight the evil that threatens to turn the world to ash.

name: Brighter Days
short_description: The last Elder Knight must stand against The Abaddon who reigns death upon those who stand in the way of his ideal Paradise. Explore and gain strength in this hand crafted open world to thwart the evil that lays waste to these Scarred Lands.
